title: Makes a difference
body: This app makes a difference by a combination of managing the most essential tasks and learning about the ADHD symptoms and tendencies. I am using it for almost a month now and I am learning about myself more each day. I am also seeing results in how I manage my symptoms. It helps me become proactive in discovering my potentials while accepting my authentic self. This app is also comforting in so many levels. They not only introduce structure but also offer sufficient examples and options to address an ADHD issue. I will love it more if they can improve the "Centering" feature. When I click it, I want to see different centering techniques or the recommended centering prompt for the day instead of leading me directly to listing my deep work tasks. I also wanna see more question prompts related to my deep work task aside from the questions that I want to answer while doing the task. I wanna see the answer to my question as well. For example, while doing the task, I wanna think about what specific reward I have set for myself for completing the task, or how do I want to spend my break time after I finish the focus sprint for a specific task. I also hope I can set a different alarm for each task instead of one schedule for doing the deep work tasks. In this way, I can include healthy breaks in between tasks. Currently, the app automatically proceeds to the next deep work task after I complete one task. A "task bank" can also be helpful for routinary tasks. This can standardize the terminologies used, icon, color and maybe the allotted time (simplification in the long run, eh?) That's all for now. I hope the app gets these upgrades soon! 🤍
